heldout.definition: an input is held out if it is not among the inputs the system's own check ran (the TRACTOR vectors, recorded in results/Test-Corpus/kiro/<battery>/test.log)

kill_rule.rule: a mutant is killed if OUR harness, on OUR inputs, reports a wrong answer (value, stdout, exit code or output file) or a crash; not counted: stderr-only differences, hangs/timeouts, kills by the system's own test

kill_rule.note: every input is run (no stop at a hang); 4 mutants hang on some input and give no wrong answer or crash on any input: undetermined, not counted; stderr-only differences are not kills
